name: Shipping Method Mismatch Between Magento and NetSuite
text_content:
Context
Investigate an inconsistency where orders placed with Free Shipping - Ground in Magento are being integrated into NetSuite with conflicting shipping information. In the identified case (JEMUS000002378), the shipping method was correctly mapped as UPS Ground, but the NetSuite shipping account field was populated with Customer Shipping Account.

Affected Order
JEMUS000002378
SO230138
JEM20755 JCI - Spokane WA

Course of Action / Solution
Ao investigar em staging a causa esta sendo devido a não enviar Customer Shipping Account #, Customer Shipping Carrier, e o netsuite estar mantendo um valor padrão quando não constam eles

estou enviando no payload Customer Shipping Account # vazio isso ja resolve
no caso de Customer Shipping Carrier tive que fazer um workflow na criação da order onde verifica o campo Use Customer Account para verificar se deve ou não limpar o campo

Important Notes
Verify total extent of this issue by checking the number of orders affected
Fix should be applied to current, past and upcoming orders
Elaborate actions that will notify and also prevent this issue from happening again

The address 3 and 4 started showing up because I had to increase the number of address lines supported in Magento from 2 to 4. There were multiple customers failing to integrate because they have > 2 address lines and Magento was refusing them.

name: Implement N8N flow to detect TaxJar vs Magento exemption status mismatches
text_content:
Context

A bug was discovered in the JEM_Tax module where sending empty exempted_states via POST /V1/company/tax-exempt caused TaxJar to receive exemption_type: wholesale + exempt_regions: []. Per TaxJar's API, wholesale with empty regions means exempt everywhere — the opposite of the intent (which was to remove the exemption).

The fix (PR #304) now correctly sends exemption_type: non_exempt when no states are provided. However, existing customers may have been synced incorrectly before the fix — they may appear as exempt in TaxJar when Magento considers them non-exempt.

Goal

Build an N8N workflow that periodically audits the exemption status between TaxJar and Magento to detect mismatches.

Flow Steps

Fetch TaxJar exempt customers — call TaxJar GET /v2/customers to get the full list of customer IDs currently marked exempt
Fetch Magento non-exempt customers — query Magento DB for customers that should NOT be in TaxJar:
tj_exemption_type = 'non_exempt' (explicitly removed)
tj_exemption_type IS NULL (never synced)
tj_exemption_type = 'wholesale' AND tj_regions = '' (affected by the pre-fix bug)
Detect mismatches — find customers who are exempt in TaxJar but non-exempt in Magento
Report — send a Slack notification with the mismatch list
Optional auto-fix — trigger POST /V1/company/tax-exempt with empty states for each mismatched company to re-sync and correct TaxJar

SQL Reference

Non-exempt Magento customer IDs:

SELECT ce.entity_id
FROM customer_entity ce
LEFT JOIN customer_entity_varchar t1
    ON t1.entity_id = ce.entity_id
    AND t1.attribute_id = (
        SELECT attribute_id FROM eav_attribute
        WHERE attribute_code = 'tj_exemption_type'
          AND entity_type_id = (SELECT entity_type_id FROM eav_entity_type WHERE entity_type_code = 'customer')
    )
LEFT JOIN customer_entity_varchar t2
    ON t2.entity_id = ce.entity_id
    AND t2.attribute_id = (
        SELECT attribute_id FROM eav_attribute
        WHERE attribute_code = 'tj_regions'
          AND entity_type_id = (SELECT entity_type_id FROM eav_entity_type WHERE entity_type_code = 'customer')
    )
WHERE t1.value = 'non_exempt'
   OR t1.value IS NULL
   OR (t1.value = 'wholesale' AND COALESCE(t2.value, '') = '');

Resolve to NetSuite customer IDs (deduped by company):

SELECT ext.netsuite_customer_id
FROM customer_entity ce
LEFT JOIN amasty_company_account_customer acu ON acu.customer_id = ce.entity_id
LEFT JOIN amasty_company_account_company acc ON acc.super_user_id = ce.entity_id
LEFT JOIN external_amasty_company_account_company ext
    ON ext.company_id = COALESCE(acu.company_id, acc.company_id)
WHERE ce.entity_id IN (/* IDs from query above */)
  AND ext.netsuite_customer_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ext.netsuite_customer_id;

Acceptance Criteria

N8N workflow runs on a schedule (daily or configurable)
Fetches full TaxJar exempt customer list in a single API call
Queries Magento for non-exempt customers (all three cases above)
Detects the intersection (in TaxJar but should be non-exempt)
Reports mismatches via Slack
(Optional) Auto-fixes by calling Magento API to re-sync affected companies

          AND entity_type_id = (SELECT entity_type_id FROM eav_entity_type WHERE entity_type_code = 'customer')
